title: Hazardous weather outlook (NWS)
description: An NWS hazardous weather outlook with Day One, Days Two to Seven and a spotter information statement. Exercise product: the template adds an exercise banner. Real NWS office, center and station identifiers; the county, places and people are fictional.

sections.description: Sections with a heading and text

heading.description: Section heading as in the product (SYNOPSIS, NEAR TERM...)

examples: Thunderstorms are expected this afternoon and evening. Some storms will be severe with damaging winds, large hail and a tornado or two possible.

examples.heading: DAY ONE...TODAY AND TONIGHT
examples.text: Thunderstorms are expected this afternoon and evening. Some storms will be severe with damaging winds, large hail and a tornado or two possible.

examples.heading: DAYS TWO THROUGH SEVEN...THURSDAY THROUGH TUESDAY
SPOTTER INFORMATION STATEMENT
examples.text: Spotter activation will be needed this afternoon and evening. Please report severe weather to the National Weather Service.
